verdict.rationale: Wise docs claim broad global payment capability including multi-currency payouts (e.g., wise-docs-2, wise-docs-6, wise-docs-12), which would cover vendor payments including US-based transfers, but there's no explicit mention of domestic ACH/wire rails. Community evidence directly contradicts reliability for this use case: users report unannounced changes to US account/routing details disrupting vendor payments on NET-30/90 terms, and even full account blocks preventing outgoing transfers.
